root_cause_summary: A deploy step stalled because the recurring-jobs Cloud Run revision failed its startup probe: the new image raised the warm-up allocation above the revision's memory limit, so the container was killed before the probe's first success and emitted no logs.
key_findings: Startup probe timed out after 4m20s; the previous deploy of the same service passed in 20s with an identical probe config
HealthCheckContainerError with zero container logs, consistent with an OOM kill before the application logger initialises
Only the recurring-jobs service was affected; 7 of 8 services healthy
Memory limit unchanged across the two revisions while the image grew
